text:
ashok: Hey team — PR up for review: `infra/kms`: switch secrets service to HSM-backed key + add audit-log headers. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821
ashok: Summary: new KMS key provider, key rotation hooks, and enforcement that every secrets create/update includes `X-Audit-Context` header. Tests + migration too.
lara: Thanks — will skim. is this breaking for existing customers or behind a flag?
ashok: non-breaking; default provider unchanged unless env `KMS_PROVIDER=hsm` is set. migration only adds metadata to DB, harmless.
matt: tagging security owners: @olivia @kevin — can one of you take a look at the HSM integration and audit header semantics?
olivia: putting on my list. quick note: we need explicit acceptance criteria for rotation TTL and monitoring in the PR description. left a comment on GH.
kevin: also check the audit header format — prefer `X-Audit-Context: {"actor":"svc:secrets","trace":"<trace-id>"}` (JSON string) vs flat key/value. will suggest in-review.
security-bot: policy-scan: found usage of `crypto.GenerateKey()` in `kms/hsm_client.go` without explicit error wrap — guidance: add context for observability. (rule: S-101)
ashok: thx, added wrap in latest commit. PTAL.
lara: quick look: code LGTM at high level. two nits in comments, and request to add a small e2e that asserts audit header lands in the event stream.
ashok: added e2e:```
# tests/integration/test_audit_header.py
def test_audit_header_present():
    resp = client.post('/v1/secrets', headers={'X-Audit-Context':'{"actor":"svc:test"}'}, json={...})
    assert event_store.last().meta['audit'] is not None
```
ashok: CI is passing locally but I see GH CI failing on `audit-events` e2e in the cloud matrix.
ci-bot: integration-tests/cloud-matrix: failed — timeout on `audit-events` while waiting for event-proxy. logs: `TimeoutError: wait_for_event proxy`
matt: that looks flaky. can you re-run? I can kick a rerun if you don't have perms.
ashok: rerun triggered. also added retry in test to be more robust.
maria: just reviewed the HSM client code. small nit (rename `hsmClient` -> `client` in constructor), otherwise LGTM. approving now.
kevin: left one comment about rotation TTL default (30d?) — prefer 90d for customer keys used in long-lived deployments. please make configurable default, not hard-coded.
ashok: made TTL configurable via env `KMS_ROTATION_DAYS` with default 90. updated PR description.
jen: planning merges during our low-traffic deploy window at 02:00 UTC. can we hold for 30m to let another reviewer look?
olivia: I'll finish my review in the next 20m.
matt: pinging SRE for monitoring: @jen-sre? we need metric `kms.rotation.success` and alert if rotation fails > 5 in 1h.
jen: noted, I'll add a monitoring ticket after merge and coordinate a follow-up patch if needed.
ci-bot: integration-tests/cloud-matrix: all checks passed on re-run.
olivia: left one remaining suggestion about audit log schema — minor. overall approve after that change.
ashok: pushed schema tweak. any objections to merge now?
kevin: LGTM, approving.
maria: approved earlier.
jen: merging in 10 to align with window. no blocker.
ashok: thanks all — merged and deployed to staging. will watch metrics and post update in #incidents if anything odd. :rocket:
